title: Fixes #11605 - GetCurrencyCode Error
summary: The GetCurrencyCode procedure in the CODA Statement table now returns an empty string instead of throwing an error when the bank account is not found.
key_points: GetCurrencyCode no longer raises an error if bank account lookup fails
The procedure returns an empty string in that case
Affects CODA statement handling in Belgium localization
Error condition previously prevented normal processing
quote: The GetCurrencyCode() procedure should not throw an error if the Bank Account is not found.
